evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 이 저장소의 docs/follow-ups를 한 번 훑어서 처리해줘. 유효한 항목이 다섯 개 있고 하나는 필수 필드가 빠져 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response reports the invalid file without inventing evidence, considers valid items in discovery order, starts at most three isolated workers, and returns one terminal outcome per considered follow-up.
expectations: It uses the bundled list and identity seams against the fetched remote default branch rather than scanning a stale coordinator checkout or creating one recurring schedule per file.
It reports the incomplete file as invalid-follow-up and does not fill in missing evidence.
It starts no more than three actual workers even when more candidates exist.
Each writing worker gets its own worktree and branch.
It returns only the skill's declared terminal outcomes and does not merge any pull request.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups docs/follow-ups/intermittent-ci-timeout.md 를 worker로 처리해. base SHA와 worktree는 검증됐는데, 기록된 명령을 여러 번 실행해도 증상이 재현되지 않아.
evals.expected_output: The worker stops before a speculative product-source edit, returns not-reproduced with concrete attempts and the next useful evidence, preserves the follow-up, and lets the coordinator mark the attempt and clean the unchanged worker.
expectations: It attempts the recorded reproduction before modifying product source.
It makes no speculative fix and opens no resolution pull request.
It retains the follow-up file.
It returns not-reproduced with concrete evidence and a useful next condition.
It records the unchanged attempt identity and compact decisive evidence so every sweep does not repeat it and later reports retain the useful next condition.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups docs/follow-ups/account-deletion-retention.md 를 처리해. 문제는 재현됐지만 올바른 보존 기간을 7일로 할지 30일로 할지 결정된 문서나 테스트가 없어.
evals.expected_output: The worker returns needs-shaping without choosing a retention policy or patching the product, preserves the follow-up, and identifies the one unsettled decision for shape-idea.
expectations: It distinguishes successful reproduction from authority to choose intended behavior.
It does not choose seven or thirty days on its own.
It makes no product patch or resolution pull request.
It preserves the follow-up and returns needs-shaping.
It names the retention-policy choice for a later shape-idea session.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 를 Claude Routine에서 실행해. WorktreeCreate가 fetch 실패 시 중단하고 전달한 base SHA를 보장하도록 설정되어 있어.
evals.expected_output: The Routine uses native worktree-isolated subagents for eligible items, requires each worker to verify its HEAD against the supplied base SHA, and does not spawn nested Claude CLI processes merely to duplicate isolation.
expectations: It resolves attempt identity before dispatch.
It atomically claims the attempt before dispatch and gives the winning owner token to the worker.
It uses isolation: worktree subagents because the creation-time freshness guarantee is present.
It binds the native checkout to the exact attempt and owner before editing.
It requires each worker to compare HEAD with the identity base SHA before editing.
It does not launch nested Claude CLI workers solely for isolation.
It preserves one follow-up per worker and pull request.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 를 Claude Routine에서 실행해. native worktree는 켤 수 있지만 fetch 실패 시 로컬 HEAD로 fallback하는 기본 설정뿐이고 WorktreeCreate 검증은 없어.
evals.expected_output: The Routine does not treat the fallback-prone native worktree as a verified base. It uses the deterministic prepare seam and a top-level headless Claude worker rooted in that prepared checkout, or reports blocked if it cannot establish that boundary.
expectations: It does not claim the default native worktree guarantees the fetched remote base.
It uses prepare to fetch, create, and verify a dedicated worktree before editing.
It starts the worker from the prepared checkout rather than the coordinator checkout.
It reports blocked without editing if the strict base cannot be established.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 를 Codex Scheduled task에서 실행해. Scheduled task 자체는 background worktree에서 시작됐고 처리할 항목은 두 개야.
evals.expected_output: The scheduled task remains a coordinator, prepares two separately verified worktrees and branches, and starts one top-level codex exec worker rooted in each checkout instead of using the coordinator worktree for both edits.
expectations: It does not treat the scheduled run's one worktree as per-item isolation.
It atomically claims, prepares, and verifies a separate owned worktree and branch for each follow-up.
It starts each Codex worker with its own working-directory boundary.
It produces independent pull-request outcomes and never auto-merges them.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 재실행이야. identity 결과가 pull-request이고 https://github.com/acme/app/pull/44가 같이 기록돼 있어. PR은 아직 OPEN이야.
evals.expected_output: The sweep verifies the referenced pull request is still open, reports skipped-unchanged with that URL, and starts no duplicate worker or pull request for the same attempt.
expectations: It checks the recorded pull request rather than ignoring local attempt state.
It reports skipped-unchanged while the pull request remains open.
It does not clear the attempt, create a new branch, or open a duplicate pull request.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 재실행이야. 기록된 PR은 CLOSED지만 merge되지 않았고 follow-up 내용과 base SHA는 그대로야.
evals.expected_output: The sweep verifies the unmerged close, clears only that exact attempt identity, and permits a fresh isolated retry without deleting the tracked follow-up or unrelated attempt state.
expectations: It distinguishes an unmerged close from an open or merged pull request.
It clears only the exact follow-up and base identity.
It retains the tracked follow-up.
It retries through a fresh isolated branch and worktree rather than reusing a dirty checkout.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups docs/follow-ups/metro-platform-cache-leak.md worker야. 증상과 원인을 재현했고 결정 문서에 플랫폼별 캐시 분리가 확정되어 있어. 수정 뒤 두 플랫폼 검증도 통과했어.
evals.expected_output: The worker commits the verified fix and deletion of only the resolved follow-up, pushes its isolated branch, opens one ready-for-review pull request with before-and-after evidence, returns the URL, and does not merge it.
expectations: It uses the settled platform-isolation behavior rather than inventing a new contract.
It retains before-and-after reproduction evidence and relevant runtime verification.
It deletes only the resolved follow-up in the fix branch.
It opens one independent ready-for-review pull request.
It returns pull-request with the URL and does not merge.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 실행 중 두 follow-up이 모두 같은 auth middleware 파일과 테스트를 바꿀 가능성이 있어. 둘 다 재현 명령은 있어.
evals.expected_output: The sweep treats independence as unproven, processes the items separately rather than concurrently, and still preserves distinct worktrees, branches, and pull requests.
expectations: It does not infer independence merely because the follow-ups are separate files.
It avoids concurrent writes to the overlapping auth scope.
It retains one isolated worker, branch, and pull request per follow-up.
One result does not get combined into the other's diff.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups worker를 준비하려는데 origin의 default branch fetch가 실패했고 로컬 HEAD는 어제 커밋이야. 로컬 기준으로라도 고쳐서 PR 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: The response refuses the stale local fallback, returns blocked before editing or creating a resolution pull request, and preserves the follow-up with the failed base condition visible.
expectations: It requires a fetched and verified remote default-branch base.
It does not fall back to the stale local HEAD despite the request.
It makes no product edit and opens no resolution pull request.
It reports blocked with the fetch condition and keeps the follow-up.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups 재실행이야. prepare가 반환한 owner, worktree, branch는 남아 있지만 worker 프로세스가 종료된 뒤 mark 전에 세션이 끊겼어.
evals.expected_output: The coordinator verifies the owning worker is no longer active, cleans up the exact bound worktree when it exists and is safe, or skips cleanup for a persisted target that was never created; it then recovers the claim with the recorded attempt key and owner and makes the unchanged item eligible again without clearing an active or terminal attempt.
expectations: It does not leave the interrupted claimed identity permanently suppressed.
It verifies that the owning process ended instead of recovering a claim merely because it is old.
When the recorded worktree exists, it cleans up only the path bound to the exact attempt and owner before recovery.
It recovers directly when preparation persisted a target but never created that worktree path.
It uses recover only for a non-terminal attempt and does not overwrite a terminal outcome.
It permits a fresh isolated retry after recovery.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups worker가 선택된 캐시 증상 대신 별도의 재현 가능한 라우팅 결함을 발견했어. 선택 항목은 그대로 열어둬야 해.
evals.expected_output: The worker returns the new defect's five evidence fields to the coordinator without leaving the only record in its disposable checkout. Before worker cleanup, the coordinator serializes and commits the follow-up record, then publishes a dedicated ready-for-review follow-up-record pull request while preserving the selected item.
expectations: It keeps the selected follow-up open and does not mix the different defect into a resolution pull request.
It returns symptom, observed evidence, suspected cause, what was tried, and proposed next step to the coordinator.

The coordinator records the new follow-up through project-knowledge when available or the same five-field format otherwise, commits it, and publishes a dedicated ready-for-review follow-up-record pull request.
It does not clean up a disposable worker that contains the only copy of the new evidence.

evals.prompt: /resolve-follow-ups prepare 직후 post-checkout hook이 추적되지 않은 파일을 만들었고, HEAD와 branch는 요청값과 일치해.
evals.expected_output: The dispatcher rejects the dirty worker before dispatch, records the exact attempt as blocked with recovery ownership, preserves the follow-up, and never lets the unrelated hook output enter a resolution pull request.
expectations: It treats a clean status as part of the prepare and bind boundary rather than checking only HEAD and branch.
It stops before product editing or worker dispatch.
It preserves the selected follow-up and reports blocked with the dirty-checkout evidence.
It cleans or recovers only through the exact attempt owner.
